# awscc_scn_instance (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::SCN::Instance



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the instance.
- `aws_account_id` (String) The AWS account ID that owns the instance.
- `created_time` (String) The instance creation timestamp.
- `instance_description` (String) The instance description.
- `instance_id` (String) The instance identifier.
- `instance_name` (String) The instance name.
- `last_modified_time` (String) The instance last modified timestamp.
- `state` (String) The state of the instance.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags for the instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `version_number` (Number) The version number of the instance.
- `web_app_dns_domain` (String) The WebApp DNS domain name of the instance.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
